assumptions: Admin path means the admin API group plus any endpoint whose path starts with admin (includes app group admin/stats).
The role lives on users.role and is read by db.get on the user id from $auth.id.
'filtering by org_id' means any org_id predicate, with no value to compare against.
Policy tags soc2 and hipaa are the template's frameworks; they are policy tags, not workspace tags.
confusions: The skill says a policy file is at policies/<KEY>.xs and a name must exist; for AUTH-020 the template rule's needs list includes write rule, which was unclear to drop when only one rule was wanted. The 'keep its rules' guidance vs 'add only what the request asks' conflict was not spelled out.

The recipe 'Keep admin endpoints for admins' says to add an admin tag only when paths do not share a prefix; the admin endpoints do share /admin, so no tag, but the recipe also says AUTH-002 selects by path in that case. Consistent, but the recipe text is dense.
Templates list AUTH-020 as an owner-field rule. Applying it to org_id required reading the check description to confirm that field plus no compare_to is valid.
wished_for: A template or example for a tenant or org scoping rule (field = org_id with compare_to from the caller's org) and guidance on whether support staff are exempt.
Guidance on how to treat a scoped endpoint that touches a table but whose existing logic is out of policy: whether to fix it or leave the finding.
A reminder in the admin recipe that the role check should cover the app-group admin endpoints under the path, since the admin endpoint group alone would miss admin/stats.
parse_errors_seen: AUTH-002.R1: Function "require_admin_role" is not on this branch (expected: the function is new in this change)
dry_run_problems_seen: none blocking; dry run exit 0, 2 policies, 1 function, 5 endpoints updated
why_confidence: AUTH-002 enforces the role-check-first call on every endpoint under the admin path, which matches the ask's mechanics, but it only checks that the call is first and passes the user, not that the function enforces admin or support_lead correctly. AUTH-020 checks that tenants reads and writes carry an org_id filter, but without a compare_to it does not check the filter's value, and three existing endpoints will fail it until the customer decides how to scope them. Neither policy has been evaluated; the findings are a prediction from the rule text, not a run.
